original_value: This study examines innovation-oriented teaching platforms through a data-mining and stochastic evolutionary game framework. A simulation model is built to analyze how subsidies, platform incentives, and participant strategies interact in educational innovation environments. The results identify a stable incentive threshold for improving platform adoption and teaching effectiveness, and provide policy implications for education administrators and developers.

result.paraphrase: This study uses a data-mining approach and a stochastic evolutionary game framework to examine innovation-focused teaching platforms. A simulation model is developed to analyze the interaction among subsidies, platform incentives, and participant strategies in educational innovation settings. The findings reveal a stable incentive threshold for enhancing platform adoption and teaching effectiveness, offering policy implications for education administrators and developers.
